title: Sections of internal Hom identify with additive module morphisms
statement: For a scheme X and a commutative condensed ring Lambda, let R be the associated internal ring sheaf on the pro-etale site of X [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category, def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For every internal R-module P, the functor Mod.ihom P followed by the specified condensedModuleSections is naturally isomorphic to the additive-group-valued Hom(P,-) functor. There is no noetherianity, boundedness, or freeness hypothesis.

source.place: Declaration docstring: evaluation on K-injective resolutions and locally finite free tensor calculation; Stacks 08JJ and HRS Lemma 5.3(2)

proof.text: The object X with its identity map is terminal in the pro-etale site. A map from the constant integer sheaf to an abelian sheaf F is determined by the image of 1 in F(X); conversely a section defines the map by restriction and integer multiples. These inverse additive maps commute with every sheaf morphism, giving a natural evaluation isomorphism.

source.place: Declaration docstring: evaluation on K-injective resolutions and locally finite free tensor calculation; Stacks 08JJ and HRS Lemma 5.3(2)

proof.text: The free-module adjunction identifies additive maps from the regular R-module with maps from the tensor unit into the underlying sheaf. The right unit isomorphism identifies the free module on this unit with the regular module. Consequently Hom(R,-) is the specified module-sections functor.

source.place: Declaration docstring: evaluation on K-injective resolutions and locally finite free tensor calculation; Stacks 08JJ and HRS Lemma 5.3(2)

proof.text: The tensor-Hom adjunction at the regular module identifies Hom(R,ihom(P,M)) with Hom(R tensor_R P,M). The tensor unit identifies R tensor_R P with P, naturally in M. Compose with the preceding sections isomorphism.

theorem condensed_internal_hom_sections
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X)) :
    Nonempty (Mod.ihom P ⋙ condensedModuleSections Λ X ≅ preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (op P))
